Limitations of field: fragmented retrieval chunks, graph overhead and parser dependence, separate optimization of retrieval and generation, agentic overhead, unrealistic Python-centric benchmarks, contamination, evaluation outside IDE/CI. Future: richer artefacts (issues, docs, logs, architecture), multilingual support, realistic benchmarks measuring efficiency and maintainability, tighter retrieval-reasoning-generation integration. fields.why: Five platforms (ACM DL, IEEE Xplore, arXiv, OpenReview, ACL Anthology) plus full collection of 14 venues, manual scanning and backward snowballing (p. 7) meet the DARE 'Yes' level (4+ sources plus another strategy); but the keywords are not reported and r1 scored Partly, so it remains a judgement
fields.doubt: Cinco bibliotecas mais snowballing cumprem o 'Yes' da escala DARE, mas as palavras-chave da pesquisa não são dadas. Decide se a falta das strings baixa para Partly.

fields.v: Partly (0.5): candidates assessed for relevance, methodological clarity and reproducibility (extra requirements for preprints), used only as a filter; no per-study quality reported
Partly (0.5): studies classified in taxonomy tables and described narratively by category; no systematic per-study data (results, settings)
fields.why: Taxonomy tables and figures (pp. 10, 13, 23) name individual systems with retrieval and integration features, which could count as information on each study (Yes); no per-study results or settings for all 152 papers, so Partly is defensible. Tables are jumbled in the text extraction
fields.doubt: As tabelas de taxonomia (pp. 10, 13, 23) listam sistemas individuais, mas não resultados por estudo. Vê as tabelas no PDF e decide entre Yes e Partly.
